title: Power Apps: Power Platform connectors in generative pages
summary: Hold: the endpoint-filtering route omits the admin center navigation and the step to edit a policy, and the connection-reference GET call only reads records rather than configuring them. The roadmap facts and documented connector capabilities are supported; the licensing model and shortened data-policy route also need minor corrections.

claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown, despite the stated product-level premium use-rights requirement.
claims.quote: Every user who runs a model-driven app needs a license that provides Power Apps premium use rights.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'.
